explanation: Total people = 100. People who graduated from college Y = 65. Therefore, people who did not graduate from college Y = 100 - 65 = 35. People who live in city Z = 30. To maximize the number of people who did not graduate from Y AND do not live in Z, we assume that all 30 people living in Z are also among those who graduated from Y. This way, the 35 people who did not graduate from Y are entirely separate from the group living in Z. In this scenario, all 35 people who did not graduate from Y could also not live in Z. This is N(Y' ∩ Z') = Total - N(Y U Z). N(Y U Z) is minimized when N(Y ∩ Z) is maximized. Max N(Y ∩ Z) = min(65, 30) = 30. So, N(Y U Z) = N(Y) + N(Z) - N(Y ∩ Z) = 65 + 30 - 30 = 65. Thus, N(Y' ∩ Z') = 100 - 65 = 35.

explanation:
At 12 noon, both hands point to 12. If 12 is North-East, this means the clock face has been rotated 45 degrees clockwise (North has become North-East). 
Standard direction mapping:
North -> North-East
East -> South-East
South -> South-West
West -> North-West
At 1:30 p.m.:
- The minute hand points to 6. Standard 6 is South. After rotation, South becomes South-West.
- The hour hand is halfway between 1 and 2. In a standard clock, this position is 45 degrees clockwise from 12 (North), which is North-East. After the clock face is rotated such that North becomes North-East, the standard North-East position would now point towards East.
subject: iq

explanation:
October has 31 days. To find the day of the week for November 1st, we need to find the number of days between October 1st and November 1st, which is 31 days. 
Divide 31 by 7 (days in a week): 31 ÷ 7 = 4 with a remainder of 3. 
This means November 1st will be 3 days after Sunday. 
Sunday + 1 day = Monday
Sunday + 2 days = Tuesday
Sunday + 3 days = Wednesday

explanation:
Let A be the number of students in Hall A and B in Hall B. 
1) A - 10 = B + 10 => A - B = 20
2) A + 20 = 2(B - 20) => A + 20 = 2B - 40 => A - 2B = -60
Subtracting (2) from (1): (A - B) - (A - 2B) = 20 - (-60) => B = 80.
Substitute B=80 into (1): A - 80 = 20 => A = 100.
So, A = 100, B = 80.
subject: iq
